Database.//: ADR 0012. Provider: Postgres (default, required in Production) or InMemory (beta pilot only — no external DB, wiped on every restart). SeedOnStartup: dev/demo seeders run at startup; a beta pilot flips this to false once real menu/floor/staff data has been entered via admin.

ConnectionStrings.//: Postgres (brasa_app, unprivileged) is what the app connects as at runtime, so RLS actually applies — see docs/architecture/multi-tenancy.md. PostgresMigrations (brasa, superuser) runs DDL only. PostgresSystem (brasa_system, DAT-07) is read-only and cross-tenant — used only when ITenantContext.ResolveAsSystem() is called, for background jobs and migrations, never a request path — see infra/initdb/02-system-role.sql.

RateLimiting.//: Per (tenant, X-Brasa-Client client id) on /api/** — API-12. Every current client shares one 'unknown' bucket per tenant since none send X-Brasa-Client yet, so this is deliberately generous — a real backstop against a runaway client, not tuned to a single terminal's traffic. Revisit once per-terminal keying exists.
